title: Library Closing Notice
passage:
CITY LIBRARY NOTICE
The second floor will close at 4:00 p.m. on Friday for a safety inspection. The first floor and the children’s room will remain open until 8:00 p.m. Visitors may return books at the front desk or in the box beside the main entrance.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To explain a partial early closing
To invite children to an event
questions.answer: To explain a partial early closing
choiceTranslations: 說明部分區域提早關閉
choiceExplanations: 二樓四點關閉，其他區域仍開放，因此是部分提早關閉的通知。
沒有介紹新圖書館。
提到兒童閱覽室仍開放，不是邀請活動。
沒有提到書籍售價。
questions.evidence: The second floor will close at 4:00 p.m. on Friday for a safety inspection.
questions.explanation: 二樓四點關閉，其他區域仍開放，因此是部分提早關閉的通知。

choices: At the front desk or entrance box
questions.answer: At the front desk or entrance box
choiceTranslations: 服務台或入口旁的還書箱
choiceExplanations: 原文並未指定二樓還書，而且二樓會提早關閉。
原文明列 front desk 與 main entrance 旁的 box 兩個位置。
兒童閱覽室開放，但未列為還書地點。
原文沒有這個還書地點。
questions.evidence: Visitors may return books at the front desk or in the box beside the main entrance.
questions.explanation: 原文明列 front desk 與 main entrance 旁的 box 兩個位置。

title: Delivery Schedule Update
passage:
To: Store Managers
From: Nina Lopez
Subject: Friday deliveries
Because of heavy rain, the trucks scheduled to arrive before noon on Friday may be delayed by up to two hours. Please ask an employee to check the loading area at 1:00 p.m. If a delivery has not arrived by then, contact the regional office. Saturday deliveries are not affected.

questions.prompt: Why might the trucks arrive late?
choiceExplanations: 没有說卸貨區關閉。
沒有說辦公室搬遷。
Because of heavy rain 直接說明延遲原因。
沒有說商店延後營業。
questions.evidence: Because of heavy rain, the trucks scheduled to arrive before noon on Friday may be delayed by up to two hours.
questions.explanation: Because of heavy rain 直接說明延遲原因。

questions.prompt: What should managers do first at 1:00 p.m.?
choiceExplanations: 週六配送不受影響，不應取消。
原文不是先打給司機。
先請員工查看卸貨區；尚未到貨才聯絡區域辦公室。
沒有要求關閉商店。
questions.evidence: Please ask an employee to check the loading area at 1:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 先請員工查看卸貨區；尚未到貨才聯絡區域辦公室。

choiceExplanations: 週五中午前預定抵達的車輛可能延遲。
原文未保證週五下午配送完全不變。
regional 指應聯絡的辦公室，不是保證不受影響的配送種類。
原文明確說週六配送不受影響。
questions.explanation: 原文明確說週六配送不受影響。
